description.narrative: El Salvador Investment Compact - Infrastructure Project - National Highway Activity: The Coastal Highway Expansion Activity seeks to relieve congestion at the most-trafficked segment of El Salvador's coastal highway ("CA-2"). The CA-2 is one of the two most important logistical corridors in the country and connects the country's major logistical nodes, including its two sea ports (La Union and Acajutla) and SAL. The Activity will finance three segments of CA-2: the 7.22 kilometer segment from Comalapa to La Herradura, the 16.98 kilometer segment from La Herradura to Zacatecoluca, and the 2.97 kilometer segment from La Libertad intersection to the Comapala Airport Road intersection.
